usage: NFL injury designations and expected return dates for every player in this league's pool, keyed by ESPN player id. Joined by player id, never by name. A compact subset of each record is already attached inline as the player's `injury` block in rosters.json, player_index.json and recent_form_rankings.json, so a player's injury travels with them everywhere they appear; this file carries the full detail including the beat note. on_nfl_ir means the NFL team placed the player on injured reserve. in_fantasy_ir_slot means this league's manager parked them in the fantasy IR slot. The two are different and routinely disagree: ir_on_nfl_but_active_slot lists players burning an active roster spot while on NFL IR, and ir_slot_but_not_on_nfl_ir lists fantasy IR slots holding someone the NFL has not designated. expected_return is ESPN's estimate; a date in February means out for the season, and expected_return_label says so in words. A designation of IR-R means designated to return.

4038524.name: Gardner Minshew II
4038524.note: Per Adam Schefter of ESPN, Minshew (elbow) is reportedly seeking additional medical opinions to confirm that he likely will require season-ending surgery to address a torn UCL.

4360761.name: Michael Wilson
4360761.note: Coach Mike LaFleur revealed Monday that Wilson is out for the season due to a fracture in his neck, Josh Weinfuss of ESPN.com reports.

3045147.name: James Conner
3045147.note: Cardinals head coach Mike LaFleur said Tuesday that Conner (foot) won't return from IR this week, Darren Urban of the team's official site reports.

4870808.name: Jeremiyah Love
4870808.note: Arizona placed Love (ankle) on injured reserve Tuesday, Darren Urban of the Cardinals' official site reports.

3045523.name: Kendrick Bourne
3045523.note: Arizona placed Bourne (tibia) on injured reserve Tuesday, Darren Urban of the Cardinals' official site reports.

4241474.name: Brian Robinson Jr.
4241474.note: Robinson (hamstring) was placed on injured reserve Saturday, Marc Raimondi of ESPN.com reports.

3916387.name: Lamar Jackson
3916387.note: Jackson, who is scheduled to undergo surgery on his injured right thumb, has told teammates he plans to return later this season, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

4035671.name: Tyler Huntley
4035671.note: Huntley (toe) was placed on injured reserve Thursday.

4685526.name: Adam Randall
4685526.note: Randall (neck) is officially listed as questionable for Thursday's game versus the Jaguars, Ryan Mink of the Ravens' official site reports.

4241476.name: Tyrell Shavers
4241476.note: Shavers (knee) was not activated from the reserve/PUP list ahead of Monday night's matchup with Minnesota, per the NFL's official transaction log.

4430034.name: Xavier Legette
4430034.note: Panthers head coach Dave Canales said Monday that Legette (knee) will be designated for return from injured reserve this week, Joe Person of The Athletic reports.

4678008.name: Jonathon Brooks
4678008.note: Head coach Dave Canales said Monday that the Panthers will spend the next two days discussing the status of Brooks (core), Mike Kaye of ESPN.com reports.

4685278.name: Luther Burden III
4685278.note: Burden has a concussion, head coach Ben Johnson revealed after Sunday's 27-24 win over the Buccaneers, Courtney Cronin of ESPN.com reports.

15168.name: Case Keenum
15168.note: Keenum (coach's decision) is inactive but serving as the Bears' emergency No. 3 quarterback for Sunday Night Football versus the Buccaneers.

4257364.name: Zavier Scott
4257364.note: The Bears placed Scott (wrist) on injured reserve Thursday.

4368003.name: Andrei Iosivas
4368003.note: Head coach Zac Taylor said Monday that Iosivas is doing well in his recovery from left thumb surgery, and the Bengals will "continue to work through this week" to determine when the receiver might return from injured reserve, Laurel Pfahler of the Dayton Daily News reports.

4427834.name: Erick All Jr.
4427834.note: Bengals head coach Zac Taylor confirmed Wednesday that All has been diagnosed with a torn ACL in his right knee and will require season-ending surgery, Jay Morrison of SI.com reports.

4429676.name: Tyler Goodson
4429676.note: Cowboys head coach Brian Schottenheimer said Monday that Goodson will miss "multiple weeks" after spraining his knee in Sunday's 27-23 win over the Colts, Todd Archer of ESPN.com reports.

4426485.name: Jonathan Mingo
4426485.note: Mingo (ankle) is questionable to return to Sunday's matchup against the Colts, Patrik Walker of the Cowboys' official site reports.

4372016.name: Jaylen Waddle
4372016.note: Waddle (concussion) has been ruled out for the remainder of Sunday's game against the Panthers, Parker Gabriel of The Denver Post reports.

4361529.name: Isiah Pacheco
4361529.note: Lions coach Dan Campbell said Friday that Pacheco (back) has a chance to return in late December, Justin Rogers of DetroitFootball.net reports.

3149687.name: Chris Brooks
3149687.note: As Week 10 approaches, Rob Demovsky of ESPN.com indicates that Brooks (ankle) may be ready to return from IR.

4259305.name: Bo Melton
4259305.note: Melton exited Sunday's game against the Patriots and is being evaluated for a concussion.

4586312.name: Jaylin Noel
4586312.note: Noel, who was placed on injured reserve earlier Wednesday, is expected to require surgery to address his toe injury and will miss the remainder of the season, Jonathan M. Alexander of the Houston Chronicle reports.

2998565.name: Mo Alie-Cox
2998565.note: Alie-Cox is questionable to return to Sunday's game against Dallas due to a groin injury.

4360078.name: Alec Pierce
4360078.note: When asked Wednesday when Pierce (heel) might be able to return to practice, Colts head coach Shane Steichen noted that he "can't put a timetable on it right now," Kevin Bowen of 107.5 The Fan Indianapolis reports.

4683062.name: Xavier Worthy
4683062.note: Coach Andy Reid said Monday that Worthy (hamstring) is considered day-to-day in advance of Sunday's game against the Falcons, Matt McMullen of the Chiefs' official site reports.

3139477.name: Patrick Mahomes
3139477.note: Chiefs coach Andy Reid said Monday that Mahomes (elbow) is considered day-to-day as this Sunday's game against the Falcons approaches, Sam McDowell of The Kansas City Star reports.

4612826.name: Ladd McConkey
4612826.note: Chargers coach Jim Harbaugh noted Monday that McConkey is viewed as "day to day" with back spasms, Alex Insdorf of BoltBeat.com reports.

4038941.name: Justin Herbert
4038941.note: Chargers coach Jim Harbaugh relayed Monday that Herbert (finger) avoided a fracture in his left middle finger,  Alex Insdorf of BoltBeat.com reports.

3123076.name: David Njoku
3123076.note: Njoku (fibula) wasn't activated from IR-designated to return ahead of Sunday's game against the Texans, per the NFL's official transaction log.

4570037.name: Terrance Ferguson
4570037.note: Coach Sean McVay noted Sunday that Ferguson pulled his hamstring during Friday's practice and will likely be sidelined for another couple of weeks, Sarah Barshop of ESPN.com reports.

5082269.name: Dean Connors
5082269.note: Connors (hand) was placed on IR on Tuesday, Blaine Grisak of SI.com reports.

4242512.name: Malik Willis
4242512.note: Willis completed 13 of 25 passes for 128 yards with no touchdowns and one interception and added two rushes for seven yards in the Dolphins' 19-9 loss to the Lions on Sunday.

4880236.name: Will Kacmarek
4880236.note: Kacmarek is dealing with a quad injury and is questionable to return to Sunday's clash against Detroit.

4569173.name: Rhamondre Stevenson
4569173.note: Stevenson is dealing with a knee tendon issue that isn't slated to require surgery but may require him to miss "a short period of time," Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

4239996.name: Travis Etienne Jr.
4239996.note: Head coach Kellen Moore said Wednesday that the Saints haven't opened Etienne's (hamstring) practice window just yet, Jeff Nowak of WWL Louisiana reports.

4040655.name: Darnell Mooney
4040655.note: Mooney (chest) was estimated to be a limited participant at the Giants' walkthrough practice Monday, Dan Salomone of the team's official site reports.

4433970.name: J.J. McCarthy
4433970.note: McCarthy (hip) is listed as limited on Monday's practice estimate, Dan Salomone of the Giants' official site reports.

4035687.name: Michael Pittman Jr.
4035687.note: Pittman (foot) said Monday that he resumed running last week as part of a program to return, but the wideout acknowledged that he's without a clear timeline to be activated from injured reserve, Ray Fittipaldo of the Pittsburgh Post-Gazette reports.

4360438.name: Brandon Aiyuk
4360438.note: The 49ers reinstated Aiyuk (personal) from the reserve/left squad list Monday and were granted a two-week roster exemption for the wide receiver, Tom Pelissero of Netflix reports.

3895856.name: Christian Kirk
3895856.note: The 49ers placed Kirk (knee) on injured reserve Saturday.

3924327.name: Drew Lock
3924327.note: Seahawks coach Mike Macdonald said Monday that Lock's tests on his oblique injury were "good," and the issue is something the QB is expected to manage ahead of Sunday's game against the Raiders,  Gregg Bell of The Tacoma News Tribune reports.

4430834.name: Jalen McMillan
4430834.note: Head coach Todd Bowles suggested Monday that McMillan (knee) isn't likely to immediately return to action following the Buccaneers' Week 10 bye, Rick Stroud of the Tampa Bay Times reports.

4360635.name: Chig Okonkwo
4360635.note: Okonkwo was deemed a limited participant on Washington's estimated practice report Monday due to a hip injury, John Keim of ESPN.com reports.

4361577.name: Dyami Brown
4361577.note: The Commanders placed Brown (calf) on injured reserve Saturday.

3127586.name: Jeremy McNichols
3127586.note: McNichols, who suffered a foot injury Sunday against the Eagles that may require surgery, is out for the season, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.
